Professional Summary
Digital marketing and talent acquisition professional with cross-functional experience in performance campaigns, analytics, and recruitment. Proven track record driving lead growth, optimizing paid media, and improving hiring pipelines using data-driven approaches and marketing automation.

Technical Skills
SEO, Google Ads, Google Analytics, Social Media Marketing, HubSpot, Recruitment, Talent Acquisition, Jira

Work Experience

Digital Marketing Manager, Kite Learning (Dec 2025 - Present)
- Led multi-channel campaigns that increased qualified leads by 42% year-over-year through optimization of Social Media Marketing and targeted ad creative; implemented HubSpot workflows to automate lead nurturing and reduce lead response time by 35%.
- Implemented Google Analytics tracking and dashboarding to attribute conversions across channels, improving cost-per-lead by 28% and enabling weekly reporting cycles.
- Coordinated cross-functional sprints with product and content teams using Jira to prioritize landing page experiments and SEO-driven content updates.

Performance Marketer, Trellis Systems (Sep 2022 - Nov 2025)
- Managed Google Ads accounts spanning search and display, reducing CPA by 33% while scaling monthly conversion volume by 2.4x through bid strategy refinement and audience segmentation.
- Ran Social Media Marketing programs that increased engagement and assisted conversions; A/B tested creatives and targeting to improve click-through rates by 22%.
- Partnered with analytics to refine attribution in Google Analytics and feed insights into campaign optimizations.

Talent Acquisition Specialist, Vertex Analytics (Sep 2020 - Aug 2022)
- Owned end-to-end Recruitment for analytics and engineering roles, shortening time-to-fill by 25% by streamlining interview workflows and leveraging targeted outreach.
- Built candidate pipelines and implemented Talent Acquisition best practices, improving offer acceptance rate through structured feedback and coordinated onboarding handoffs.
- Used Jira to track hiring tasks and stakeholder approvals, ensuring SLAs for interview scheduling and candidate follow-up.

Education
M.Tech, Data Science, IIIT Hyderabad
